elements.label: Map 6.2
elements.title: Many low- and middle-income countries have not adopted strong energy codes for buildings
elements.content:
Map showing the adoption of energy codes for buildings across low- and middle-income countries based on 2025 data.
Legend categories:
- Some standards (dark green)
- Unified building energy code (medium green)
- No known code/voluntary code/code in development (light grey/white)
Source: 2025 data from Building Green (global data set), Global Indicators Group, World Bank, https://www.worldbank.org/en/building-green.
